evidence.quote: Singaporean authorities said yesterday that they have seized a luxury bungalow and charged four people with money laundering as part of an investigation linked to the alleged movement of Nvidia chips subject to U.S. export controls.
evidence.one_line: Singapore police seized a luxury bungalow and charged four people with money laundering in an investigation linked to alleged movement of export-controlled Nvidia chips.
evidence.speaker: Singapore Police Force

evidence.quote: it had issued a “prohibition of disposal order” against a residence valued at around S$55 million ($42.4 million) and seized around S$1 million of funds
evidence.one_line: SPF issued a prohibition of disposal order on a residence valued at about S$55 million ($42.4 million) and seized about S$1 million of funds.
evidence.speaker: Singapore Police Force

evidence.quote: Lim and Woon were each handed seven new charges, while Wei is set to receive seven new charges on July 6, the SPF said.
evidence.one_line: SPF said Lim and Woon were each handed seven new fraud and money laundering charges, with Wei set to receive seven new charges on July 6.
evidence.speaker: Singapore Police Force

evidence.quote: The four companies will also face a total of eight charges of fraud by false representation which are due to be announced on July 6
evidence.one_line: Four companies are due to face a total of eight fraud-by-false-representation charges, to be announced July 6; SPF called it the first prosecution of corporate entities in these investigations.
evidence.speaker: Singapore Police Force

evidence.quote: Authorities say that the servers in question, which may have contained advanced Nvidia AI chips, were shipped from Singapore to Malaysia . Although it is unclear whether this was their ultimate destination
evidence.one_line: Servers that may have contained advanced Nvidia AI chips were shipped from Singapore to Malaysia; ultimate destination unclear.
evidence.speaker: Singapore authorities

evidence.quote: Last week, Malaysian authorities said they had foiled an attempt to smuggle advanced AI chips through the country’s main airport, seizing 72 servers worth nearly $13 million.
evidence.one_line: Malaysian authorities said they foiled an attempt to smuggle advanced AI chips via the main airport, seizing 72 servers worth nearly $13 million.
evidence.speaker: Malaysian authorities

evidence.quote: The number of such cases more than tripled from 589 in the first half of 2024 to 1,762 over the same period this year, according to the Singaporean police.
evidence.one_line: Number of such cases rose from 589 in H1 2024 to 1,762 in H1 2026, per Singapore police.
evidence.speaker: Singapore Police Force
